columns.description: The variant as gnomAD's answer names it (`variant_id`): chromosome, position, reference and alternate base; the query asked for GRCh38.
columns.name: variant_id

columns.description: Its position on GRCh38 as gnomAD gives it, checked to be a coding base of NM_000540.3 by the release's exon table (check K3).
columns.name: pos

columns.description: The reference base, checked against the release's genomic sequence at `pos` (check K4) and against gnomAD's c. name (check K5).
columns.name: ref

columns.description: The alternate base, checked against gnomAD's c. name (check K5) and, through the release's codon, against its p. name (check K7); only single-base substitutions are selected.
columns.name: alt

columns.description: gnomAD's c. name as served for transcript ENST00000359596 (the gene's MANE Select, version 8 by check K2), checked to be the release's c. position with `ref` and `alt` (check K5).
columns.name: hgvsc

columns.description: gnomAD's p. name, in three-letter codes; its residue and both amino acids are checked against the release (checks K6 and K7).
columns.name: hgvsp

columns.description: The base's coding position on NM_000540.3, computed from the release's exon table.
columns.name: c_pos

columns.description: The codon that holds the base: (c_pos - 1) div 3, plus 1.
columns.name: codon

columns.description: The base's place in its codon: 1, 2 or 3.
columns.name: codon_position

columns.description: The residue that codon encodes in the release's protein, P21817-1 sequence version 3; equal to `codon`.
columns.name: residue

columns.description: The release's amino acid at `residue`, one letter, checked against gnomAD's p. name (check K6).
columns.name: ref_aa

columns.description: The release's codon with `alt` in place, translated by the standard code, one letter, checked against gnomAD's p. name (check K7); never `ref_aa` and never a stop (check K8).
columns.name: alt_aa

columns.description: Allele count in gnomAD's exomes, as served, whatever their filters; empty where the answer has no exome data for the variant.
columns.name: exome_ac

columns.description: Allele number in the exomes, as served; empty where the answer has no exome data for the variant.
columns.name: exome_an

columns.description: The exome data's filters, comma-separated; empty where they pass, or where there are no exome data (`exome_an` is then empty too).
columns.name: exome_filters

columns.description: Allele count in gnomAD's genomes, as served, whatever their filters; empty where the answer has no genome data for the variant.
columns.name: genome_ac

columns.description: Allele number in the genomes, as served; empty where the answer has no genome data for the variant.
columns.name: genome_an

columns.description: The genome data's filters, comma-separated; empty where they pass, or where there are no genome data (`genome_an` is then empty too).
columns.name: genome_filters

columns.description: Allele count in gnomAD's joint set of exomes and genomes, as served, whatever its filters; empty where the answer has no joint data. The joint set's filters were served and used for the joint grpmax and faf95_max, but this table does not hold them.
columns.name: joint_ac

columns.description: Allele number in the joint set, as served; empty where the answer has no joint data.
columns.name: joint_an

columns.description: True where the exomes or the genomes pass their filters with an allele count above 0.
columns.name: observed_pass

columns.description: The highest AC/AN among the exome groups the answer lists, less ami, asj, fin and remaining and any group whose allele number is 0 or missing, computed here and written with Python's '.6g' format (at most six significant digits, trailing zeros dropped, exponent form below 1e-4); 0 where the exome data pass with an allele count above 0 but every allele is in an excluded group; empty where the exome data are absent, fail their filters or have an allele count of 0, or no group is counted.
columns.name: exome_grpmax_af

columns.description: The counted exome group with the highest AC/AN, the first in the answer's order on a tie; where `exome_grpmax_af` is 0, the first counted group, which carries no allele; empty where `exome_grpmax_af` is empty.
columns.name: exome_grpmax_group

columns.description: That group's allele count in the exomes; 0 where `exome_grpmax_af` is 0.
columns.name: exome_grpmax_ac

columns.description: That group's allele number in the exomes.
columns.name: exome_grpmax_an

columns.description: The highest AC/AN among the genome groups the answer lists, less ami, asj, fin, remaining and mid and any group whose allele number is 0 or missing, computed here and written with Python's '.6g' format (at most six significant digits, trailing zeros dropped, exponent form below 1e-4); 0 where the genome data pass with an allele count above 0 but every allele is in an excluded group; empty where the genome data are absent, fail their filters or have an allele count of 0, or no group is counted.
columns.name: genome_grpmax_af

columns.description: The counted genome group with the highest AC/AN, the first in the answer's order on a tie; where `genome_grpmax_af` is 0, the first counted group, which carries no allele; empty where `genome_grpmax_af` is empty.
columns.name: genome_grpmax_group

columns.description: That group's allele count in the genomes; 0 where `genome_grpmax_af` is 0.
columns.name: genome_grpmax_ac

columns.description: That group's allele number in the genomes.
columns.name: genome_grpmax_an

columns.description: The highest AC/AN among the joint set's groups the answer lists, less ami, asj, fin and remaining, the empty group id and any group whose allele number is 0 or missing (exclusions this script chose, since gnomAD's help defines no joint grpmax), computed here and written with Python's '.6g' format (at most six significant digits, trailing zeros dropped, exponent form below 1e-4); 0 where the joint data pass with an allele count above 0 but every allele is in an excluded group; empty where the joint data are absent, fail their filters (which this table does not hold) or have an allele count of 0, or no group is counted.
columns.name: joint_grpmax_af

columns.description: The counted joint group with the highest AC/AN, the first in the answer's order on a tie; where `joint_grpmax_af` is 0, the first counted group, which carries no allele; empty where `joint_grpmax_af` is empty.
columns.name: joint_grpmax_group

columns.description: That group's allele count in the joint set; 0 where `joint_grpmax_af` is 0.
columns.name: joint_grpmax_ac

columns.description: That group's allele number in the joint set.
columns.name: joint_grpmax_an

columns.description: gnomAD's own filtering allele frequency for the exomes (`fafmax.faf95_max`), where they pass their filters, written with Python's '.6g' format, which rounds some served values; empty where absent. Empty in every row of this table.
columns.name: exome_faf95_max

columns.description: gnomAD's own filtering allele frequency for the genomes (`fafmax.faf95_max`), where they pass their filters, written with Python's '.6g' format, which rounds some served values; empty where absent. Empty in every row of this table.
columns.name: genome_faf95_max

columns.description: gnomAD's own filtering allele frequency for the joint set (`fafmax.faf95_max`), where it passes its filters (which this table does not hold), written with Python's '.6g' format, which rounds some served values; empty where absent or filtered.
columns.name: joint_faf95_max

columns.description: gnomAD's flags for the variant, comma-separated; empty where it has none.
columns.name: flags

columns.description: The PDB entry, one of the 26 of S13's table.
columns.name: entry

columns.description: What the row describes: `entity` (one entity of the entry and the decision on it), `chain` (one RyR1 chain and its outcome) or `entry` (the entry as a whole).
columns.name: scope

columns.description: On an entity row, its chains with a modelled residue, comma-separated (`-` if none); on a chain row, the chain's author id; on the entry row, every RyR1 chain compared, comma-separated (`-` if none).
columns.name: chain

columns.description: The entity's id in the mmCIF file; on a chain row, the chain's entity; empty on the entry row.
columns.name: entity

columns.description: On an entity row, the entity's description as the mmCIF file gives it; empty otherwise.
columns.name: description

columns.description: The entry's species, as S13's table gives it: Mus musculus, Oryctolagus cuniculus or Sus scrofa.
columns.name: species

columns.description: The UniProt accession of that species' RyR1 reference (E9PZQ0, P11716 or P16960), on whose residues the positions m_S and m_A are.
columns.name: reference

columns.description: The reference sequence's length.
columns.name: reference_length

columns.description: On an entity row, the decision on it (R1a, R7 and R1b, in that order): `RyR1`, or why it is excluded; empty otherwise.
columns.name: entity_decision

columns.description: On an entity row, for each chain, the identical and the counted residues among its modelled residues aligned in method A's representative alignment, as chain:identical/counted (GAP-01), semicolon-separated; `-` if none; empty otherwise.
columns.name: identity_with_reference

columns.description: On a chain row, SIFTS's state for the chain (R8): `mapped`, or why path S gives it no position (`none: ...`, `another accession: ...`); empty otherwise.
columns.name: path_s

columns.description: On a chain row, the chain's labels (R12): `equal`, `departs`, `disputed` or `nothing compared`, with `short departing run, path A only` (R11c) and `path A only` added where they apply, joined by '; '. On the entry row, the labels combined over its chains, or why it was not analysed (`refused by R7: ...`, `no RyR1 entity`). Empty on entity rows.
columns.name: outcome

columns.description: On the entry row, where chains of one entity differ in their labels or departing offsets, each chain's, semicolon-separated; `-` if none; empty otherwise.
columns.name: outcome_notes

columns.description: Modelled residues. On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: modelled

columns.description: Residues on which the two paths were compared: agree, disputed, path A only and path S only (K9's 'compared'). On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: compared

columns.description: Residues to which SIFTS (m_S) and method A (m_A) give the same reference position. On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: agree

columns.description: Residues at a species position whose type differs from the reference there and which the entry declares (_struct_ref_seq_dif): joined, as the structure's own residue. On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: declared_difference

columns.description: Residues to which both paths give a position, and the positions differ. On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: disputed

columns.description: Residues that only method A places (path S gives none). On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: path_a_only

columns.description: Of those, the residues in a chain SIFTS maps, which are therefore not checked against SIFTS; 0 in a chain SIFTS does not map. On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: path_a_only_residue

columns.description: Residues that only SIFTS places. On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: path_s_only

columns.description: Residues that neither path places (R10 amended). On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: neither_path

columns.description: Residues named UNK (R4): not compared. On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: unk

columns.description: Residues with an insertion code (R5): not compared. On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: insertion_code

columns.description: Residues numbered outside the reference that neither path places (R6): not compared. On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: outside

columns.description: Residues SIFTS marks Not_Observed (R8): not compared. On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: not_observed_in_sifts

columns.description: Residues that SIFTS, in a chain it maps, does not list at their chain and number, or gives more than one UniProt position, or a cross-reference with no position (GAP-07): reported, not joined. On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: sifts_anomaly

columns.description: Residues modelled as more than one type (R3): not compared. On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: microheterogeneity

columns.description: Residues at a species position whose type differs from the reference there and which the entry does not declare (R10 amended): reported, not joined. On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: undeclared_difference

columns.description: Residues counted under K9's term `refused`. On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: refused

columns.description: Residues whose author and label numbers do not pair in _pdbx_poly_seq_scheme (R3 amended): not compared. On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: pairing_disagrees

columns.description: Residues in a run whose identity at the species position is below 0.98 (R11): not joined. On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: identity_low

columns.description: Residues joined: agree or path A only, in a run neither identity-low nor a short departing run on path A alone (R11c). On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: joined

columns.description: Residues whose position on path A is ambiguous: method A's optimal alignments place them differently. On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: ambiguous_path_a

columns.description: Modelled residues with no CA atom. On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: residues_without_ca

columns.description: K9: true where the modelled residues equal the compared ones plus those under each of K9's other terms (UNK, insertion code, outside, Not_Observed in SIFTS, SIFTS anomaly, microheterogeneity, neither path, undeclared difference, refused, pairing disagrees). On a chain row, for the chain; on the entry row, summed over its chains; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: k9_sum_holds

columns.description: On chain and entry rows, the gate residue S13 measured, as S13's table gives it; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: gate_residue

columns.description: On a chain row, R14: the category of the residue at S13's author number with no insertion code (GAP-21), with ' (identity low)' where its run is identity-low, or `not modelled`; empty otherwise.
columns.name: gate_outcome

columns.description: On a chain row, that residue's species position (m_S where the paths agree, m_A where only path A places it); empty where it has none, and on other rows.
columns.name: gate_species_position

columns.description: On a chain row, the reference's amino acid at that position, one letter; `-` where there is none; empty on other rows.
columns.name: gate_reference_residue

columns.description: On a chain row, the residue's type in the structure (its component id); `-` if not modelled; empty on other rows.
columns.name: gate_structure_residue

columns.description: On a chain row: `disputed`, `departs by` and the offset, `not joined` with the category, `not modelled`, or `-`. On the entry row, each chain's note (its outcome where the note is `-`), as chain:note, semicolon-separated. Empty on entity rows.
columns.name: gate_note

columns.description: On chain and entry rows, the departing runs (R11, R12), each as chain:first-last author number:offset:residues, semicolon-separated; `-` if none; empty on entity rows.
columns.name: departing_segments

columns.description: On the entry row, O2's reads for the entry as O2's survey gives them; `-` if none; empty otherwise.
columns.name: o2_read

columns.description: On the entry row, R15: for each of O2's reads, CL-2's residues at that species position in each chain, each said to be declared, undeclared or as the reference; `-` if O2 read none; empty otherwise.
columns.name: r15_cl2_reading

columns.description: On the entry row, for each read, `agrees`, `DISAGREES`, `not located` or `not understood`, semicolon-separated; `-` if none; empty otherwise.
columns.name: r15_agreement

columns.description: On the entry row, whether a SIFTS file was read for the entry: `yes` or `no`; empty otherwise.
columns.name: sifts_file

columns.description: On the entry row, the SIFTS file's date as it states it; `-` if no file; empty otherwise.
columns.name: sifts_date

columns.description: On the entry row, the PDB dbVersion the SIFTS file states, kept as text (such as 40.26); `-` if no file; empty otherwise.
columns.name: sifts_pdb_version

columns.description: On the entry row, the UniProt dbVersion the SIFTS file states, kept as text (such as 2026.03); `-` if no file; empty otherwise.
columns.name: sifts_uniprot_version

columns.description: On the entry row, for each RyR1 entity, the number of optimal alignments method A found, as entity:count, semicolon-separated (R9 refuses above 100,000); `-` if none; empty otherwise.
columns.name: method_a_optimal_alignments

columns.description: The PDB entry.
columns.name: entry

columns.description: The chain's author id.
columns.name: chain

columns.description: The run's index in its chain, from 0, in author order (R11: a maximal run of residues with one status and offsets; GAP-11).
columns.name: segment

columns.description: The run's status: a path outcome (agree, disputed, path A only, path S only, neither path), or the class of residues not compared that it holds (such as UNK or insertion code).
columns.name: status

columns.description: SIFTS's states of the run's residues, semicolon-separated.
columns.name: path_s_note

columns.description: m_S - n over the run (SIFTS's position less the author number); empty where path S gives none.
columns.name: offset_s

columns.description: m_A - n over the run (method A's position less the author number); empty where path A gives none.
columns.name: offset_a

columns.description: The run's first author number, with its insertion code if it has one.
columns.name: author_first

columns.description: The run's last author number, with its insertion code if it has one.
columns.name: author_last

columns.description: The lowest label_seq_id among its residues that have one; empty if none.
columns.name: label_first

columns.description: The highest label_seq_id among its residues that have one; empty if none.
columns.name: label_last

columns.description: The run's first species position (m_S where the paths agree, m_A where only path A places the residue); empty if none.
columns.name: species_first

columns.description: The run's last species position; empty if none.
columns.name: species_last

columns.description: The run's modelled residues.
columns.name: n_residues

columns.description: Gaps in the author numbers inside the run, each as first-last missing number, comma-separated; `-` if none.
columns.name: unmodelled_gaps

columns.description: On a run of status agree or path A only, the residues counted for identity at the species position (all but declared differences); empty on other runs.
columns.name: identity_counted

columns.description: On such a run, the counted residues whose type is the reference's there; empty on other runs.
columns.name: identity_same

columns.description: identity_same / identity_counted, to four decimals; empty where none is counted.
columns.name: identity

columns.description: True where the identity is below 0.98 (R11, every run whatever its length; GAP-14): its residues are not joined.
columns.name: identity_low

columns.description: Declared differences in the run, which are not counted for identity.
columns.name: declared_differences

columns.description: Undeclared differences in the run, which are counted, reported and not joined.
columns.name: undeclared_differences

columns.description: True where the run's offset (offset_a on a run of path A only, offset_s otherwise) is not 0 (R12's 'departs'; GAP-13); false for a short departing run on path A alone (R11c).
columns.name: departs

columns.description: True for a run on path A alone that departs but holds fewer than 10 modelled residues (R11c, criteria 2.2): reported, not joined, and not a departing run.
columns.name: short_departing_run_path_a

columns.description: The run's residues that are joined: category agree or path A only, in a run neither identity-low nor a short departing run on path A alone.
columns.name: joined_residues

columns.description: True on a run of status agree, false on a run of path A only, empty otherwise.
columns.name: checked_against_sifts

columns.description: For a departing run, true where path A's alignment holds an insertion or deletion at the run's start boundary (R13); empty where not examined.
columns.name: boundary_indel

columns.description: For a departing run, true where auth_seq_id - label_seq_id changes across the start boundary (R13); empty where not examined.
columns.name: boundary_numbering_steps

columns.description: For a departing run, R13's reading of its boundary with the run before it (GAP-15): the deposited sequence differs from the reference there, the numbering steps there while the sequence does not, both, neither, or not determinable; `-` for other runs.
columns.name: form

columns.description: What that reading rests on, or why it is not determinable; `-` for other runs.
columns.name: form_basis

columns.description: The PDB entry.
columns.name: entry

columns.description: The chain's author id.
columns.name: chain

columns.description: Why the row is listed: the class of a residue not joined (microheterogeneity, pairing disagrees, insertion code, Not_Observed in SIFTS, SIFTS anomaly, outside, disputed, path S only, neither path, undeclared difference, refused); `UNK` for a run of UNK residues (GAP-22); `path A only (residue): not checked against SIFTS`; `short departing run, path A only (R11c): not joined`; `declared difference`; `identity low`; or `SIFTS name differs from the held reference (K10)`. A residue may be listed under more than one kind.
columns.name: kind

columns.description: The residue's author number; for a run of UNK residues, its first.
columns.name: author_first

columns.description: The residue's author number; for a run of UNK residues, its last.
columns.name: author_last

columns.description: The residue's insertion code; empty if none, and on UNK rows.
columns.name: ins_code

columns.description: The residue's label_seq_id, or its label_seq_ids comma-separated; empty on UNK rows.
columns.name: label_seq_id

columns.description: The residue's type (its component id; for microheterogeneity, the types joined by +); UNK on UNK rows.
columns.name: residue

columns.description: 1, or the residues of a run of UNK residues.
columns.name: n_residues

columns.description: The residue's category, as R3 to R10 class it (GAP-04).
columns.name: category

columns.description: SIFTS's UniProt position for the residue (path S); empty if none.
columns.name: m_s

columns.description: SIFTS's state for the residue: `mapped`, `Not_Observed`, or why path S gives no position; empty on UNK rows.
columns.name: path_s

columns.description: Method A's position for the residue (path A); empty if none.
columns.name: m_a

columns.description: Path A's state for the residue: `ok`, `gap`, `ambiguous` or `no single label_seq_id`; empty on UNK rows.
columns.name: path_a

columns.description: For a position on path A that is ambiguous, the reference positions the optimal alignments give, comma-separated (`-` for a gap); empty otherwise.
